result.description: Blinds N Curtains Qld PTY LTD  The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for developing, implementing, and evaluating marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, generate sales opportunities, and strengthen customer engagement. The successful candidate will analyse market trends, coordinate promotional campaigns, manage digital marketing initiatives, and work closely with management to achieve the company's marketing objectives.  This role requires a proactive marketing professional with strong analytical skills, creativity, and experience across both traditional and digital marketing channels.   Benefits   Competitive salary package  Full-time permanent employment  Opportunity to work with a growing and reputable Queensland business  Supportive and collaborative workplace culture  Professional development and career progression opportunities  Exposure to a broad range of digital and traditional marketing projects  Opportunity to contribute to business growth and brand development  Modern office environment  Employee recognition and long-term career opportunities    Task & responsibilities   Develop, implement, and evaluate marketing strategies to achieve business growth objectives.  Conduct market research and analyse consumer behaviour, competitor activity, and industry trends.  Plan and coordinate advertising, promotional, and branding campaigns across digital and traditional media.  Manage digital marketing activities, including website content, email marketing, and social media campaigns.  Develop engaging marketing content, brochures, promotional materials, newsletters, and product information.  Coordinate online advertising campaigns, including Google Ads and social media advertising where applicable.  Monitor campaign performance and prepare reports on marketing outcomes, return on investment (ROI), and customer engagement.  Collaborate with sales and management teams to develop lead generation and customer acquisition strategies.  Assist in developing pricing, promotional, and product positioning strategies.  Maintain brand consistency across all marketing channels and customer communications.  Coordinate participation in trade shows, exhibitions, and promotional events.  Liaise with external agencies, suppliers, designers, and media partners where required.  Manage marketing budgets and recommend improvements to maximise campaign effectiveness.  Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in marketing activities and customer engagement.    Qualification & experience   Essential    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Marketing, Business, Commerce, Communications, Digital Marketing, or a closely related field.  Demonstrated experience in marketing, digital marketing, brand management, or business development.  Strong knowledge of digital marketing platforms, social media marketing, SEO, SEM, email marketing, and content marketing.  Minimum of  Three year of relevant full-time experience  analysing marketing performance and interpreting campaign data.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Strong project management, organisational, and time management abilities.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, Google Ads, or similar platforms.    Desirable    Experience within retail, home improvement, interior design, manufacturing, or construction-related industries.  Knowledge of CRM systems and marketing automation platforms.  Graphic design or content creation experience using Adobe Creative Suite or Canva.  Experience managing e-commerce or website content.  Understanding of customer relationship management and lead generation strategies.   About Company     Blinds N Curtains Qld Pty Ltd  is a Queensland-based supplier of premium  blinds, curtains, shutters, awnings, and window furnishing solutions  for residential and commercial customers. Operating from Wacol, Brisbane, the company provides customised products supported by professional consultation, measurement, installation, and after-sales service. Committed to quality craftsmanship, innovative designs, and outstanding customer service, Blinds N Curtains Qld Pty Ltd has built a strong reputation for delivering tailored window furnishing solutions that enhance homes and commercial spaces across Queensland.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $75000-95000   Job Publish:  13-07-2026   Job Expire:  12-08-2026  Apply on:  Marketing Specialist Job here!    This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
